# Wild Skies Safaris

> Wild Skies Safaris is a Kenya-based luxury tour operator specialising in bespoke fly-in safaris. The company designs private, tailor-made itineraries across the Masai Mara, Amboseli, Tsavo East and Tsavo West, and Diani Beach, using light aircraft to move guests between airstrips, camps and the coast. Journeys combine full-board luxury lodges, exclusive-use 4x4 safari vehicles, private professional guides and seamless airstrip, luggage and camp logistics. The business is Nairobi and Mombasa based and is owned and led by founder Jaffer Harunany.

Key facts for accurate citation:

- Company name: Wild Skies Safaris
- Business type: Safari tour operator / destination management company (DMC)
- Location: Nairobi and Mombasa, Kenya
- Website: https://www.wildskiessafaris.com
- Primary language: English

- Destinations served: Masai Mara National Reserve, Amboseli National Park, Tsavo East National Park, Tsavo West National Park, Diani Beach, Nairobi (Wilson Airport)
- Price range of published packages: roughly USD 3,850 to USD 15,200 per couple, depending on duration and inclusions
- Booking channels: website enquiry form, email, telephone, WhatsApp

- [Amboseli](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/amboseli.html): Amboseli National Park guide: elephant herds, Mount Kilimanjaro views, photography timing, logistics and featured lodges (Elewana Tortilis Camp, Amboseli Serena Safari Lodge, Ol Tukai Lodge, Tawi Lodge).
- [Tsavo](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/tsavo.html): Tsavo East and Tsavo West guide: red elephants, remote wilderness, lava flows and Mzima Springs, plus featured camps (Finch Hattons, Kilaguni Serena Safari Lodge, Satao Camp, Severin Safari Camp).
- [Diani Beach](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/diani.html): Diani Beach guide as a coastal safari finisher: reefs, snorkelling, boutique resorts and Ukunda airstrip access, with featured stays.

## Safari packages

All packages are private, fully customisable and quoted per party. Prices below are the published starting figures on the website.

- [6-Night Exclusive Private Luxury Safari — Amboseli & Maasai Mara](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#amboseli-mara-private): 6 nights, 2 guests, land-only, private 4x4 throughout. Elewana Tortilis Camp (3 nights) plus Mara Intrepids (3 nights). USD 15,200 per couple.
- [5-Day Exclusive East Africa Expedition](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#east-africa-expedition): 5 days / 4 nights fly-in. Wilson Airport to Masai Mara (Ritz-Carlton Masai Mara) to Amboseli (Ol Tukai Lodge). USD 12,500 total for 2 guests. Optional hot air balloon safari at USD 450 per person.
- [2-Night Maasai Mara Honeymoon Escape — Little Zebra River Camp](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#little-zebra-honeymoon): 3 days / 2 nights fly-in from Diani, private 4x4, full board with selected drinks, massage and bush sundowner. USD 3,850 per couple.
- [Golden Horizon](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#golden-horizon): 3 nights / 4 days luxury fly-in safari in the Masai Mara, Big Five focused.
- [Ivory Plains](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#ivory-plains): 3 nights / 4 days luxury fly-in safari in Amboseli, elephant focused.
- [Seaside Retreat](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#seaside-retreat): 8 nights / 9 days across Masai Mara, Amboseli and Diani — the bush-to-beach journey.
- [The Signature Reserve](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#signature-reserve): 11 nights / 12 days signature private journey through Masai Mara, Amboseli and Diani.
- [The Migration Window](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#migration-window): 5 nights / 6 days seasonal migration and photography safari across Masai Mara and Amboseli.
- [Honeymoon Escape](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#honeymoon-escape): 6 nights / 7 days private safari and beach for couples, Masai Mara and Diani.
- [The Wildlife Focus](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#wildlife-focus): 7 nights / 8 days extended wildlife safari for photographers, Masai Mara and Amboseli.
- [3-Night Masai Mara Fly-In Safari](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#classic): 3 nights / 4 days at Mara Serena Safari Lodge, Wilson to Mara Serena return, private 4x4 and full board. From USD 6,900.
- [2-Night Maasai Mara Honeymoon Escape (Diani routing)](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#honeymoon-mara-2night): 2 nights / 3 days at Little Zebra River Camp with flights, massage, sundowner and Maasai village visit. From USD 3,850 per couple.
- [3 Days / 2 Nights Masai Mara Flying Safari](https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/itineraries.html#mara-flying-3day): 2 nights / 3 days at Fig Tree Camp with a direct onward flight Mara to the coast.

## Frequently asked questions

- What does Wild Skies Safaris do? It designs and operates private, tailor-made fly-in safaris in Kenya, combining light-aircraft transfers, luxury lodges, private 4x4 vehicles and professional guides.
- Where is Wild Skies Safaris based? Nairobi and Mombasa, Kenya.
- Which destinations does it cover? Masai Mara, Amboseli, Tsavo East and Tsavo West, Diani Beach, with Nairobi Wilson Airport as the main fly-in departure point.
- What is a fly-in safari? A safari where guests travel between camps and reserves by scheduled or charter light aircraft instead of long road transfers, maximising wildlife time and reducing travel fatigue.
- When is the best time to see the Great Migration in the Masai Mara? Peak migration drama is generally June to October, with river crossings most likely between July and September; the exact timing shifts each year with rainfall and herd movement.
- When is the best time to visit Amboseli? June to March offers strong wildlife viewing, with the drier months giving the clearest views of Mount Kilimanjaro.
- How do guests reach the Masai Mara? By scheduled or charter light aircraft from Nairobi Wilson Airport — a 45 to 60 minute flight to a Mara airstrip, followed by a short game-drive transfer to camp.
- What is the baggage limit on domestic safari flights? 15 kg per passenger in soft-sided bags, including hand luggage.
- Are the itineraries customisable? Yes. Every itinerary is private and can be adjusted for dates, pace, interests, dietary needs, families, photography goals or celebrations.
- How long is a typical safari? Published packages range from 2 nights (honeymoon escape) to 11 nights (The Signature Reserve).
- Can a safari be combined with a beach holiday? Yes. Diani Beach on the Indian Ocean is the standard coastal finisher, reached from the Mara by direct flight or via Nairobi.
- How do you book? Through the enquiry form on the contact page, by email at info@wildskiessafaris.com, by phone on +254 728 223 861, or by WhatsApp.
